title: NLRB decisions: Board, unpublished Board, and administrative law judge (listing metadata and weekly summaries)
description:
Metadata for every entry on the National Labor Relations Board's three public decision listings (Board Decisions, Unpublished Board Decisions, Administrative Law Judge Decisions), with links to each decision document and case page, plus the text of NLRB's weekly Summary of NLRB Decisions pages matched to those entries. No decision text. Not affiliated with the NLRB.

This is a monthly snapshot of the Hugging Face dataset abigailhaddad/nlrb-decisions, which is refreshed daily. Code, checks and a data dictionary: github.com/abigailhaddad/nlrb-decisions. README.md is the dataset card with counts, as-of dates and caveats.
